integrity: A complete symbolic proof is supplied; a self-contained finite exhaustive checker supplements but cannot establish the infinite claim. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The structural classification assumes two equivalence relations with information cells of size at most two; no claim is made for larger cells, non-S5 frames, or non-Boolean semantics. The enumeration is also the classical commuting-involutions census, not independently claimed as novel.
title: Knowing-whether commutation on binary-uncertainty S5 frames
